# Stakeholder Interview Notes

## Training Operations

Coordinators want to create sessions, set capacity, publish dates and
locations, identify whether approval is needed, and export attendance lists.
They also need to cancel a session and notify affected participants.

## Department Managers

Managers want a single list of requests awaiting their decision. They need to
understand the session, timing, and reason supplied by the staff member before
approving.

## Staff Representatives

Staff want search by topic, date, delivery mode, and location. They want to see
request status and avoid entering information already held by the
organization.

## Support

Support staff need to investigate access issues and see notification history.
They should not be able to change a manager's approval decision.

## Accessibility and Data Protection

The interface must meet the organization's accessibility rules. The project
should collect only information required to manage participation and should
define retention before release.
